intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m, passing through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and traditional Gurung villages. Witness breathtaking panoramic views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli peaks. This is the crown jewel of the region and a must-do for serious trekkers.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Trek to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas. Watch the golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a stunning alpenglow display. The hike from Ghorepani takes about 1.5 hours and is suitable for moderate fitness levels.

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay Experience
experiences.description: Stay overnight in a traditional Gurung or Magar village homestay along the trekking route. Share authentic dal bhat meals with local families, learn about indigenous customs, shamanic traditions, and Buddhist practices. Participate in daily village life including farming and cooking, offering a deeply immersive cultural connection with the mountain communities.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-known Mardi Himal trek, a hidden gem offering stunning high-altitude views with far fewer crowds than the main ABC route. Trek through dense forests of oak and rhododendron, alpine meadows, and rocky ridgelines up to 4,500m. Spot Himalayan wildlife including langur monkeys, deer, and various bird species along the trail.
experiences.location: Mardi Himal, Eastern Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Pokhara Lakeside Nature and Kayaking
experiences.description: Spend a rest day in Pokhara kayaking on the serene Phewa Lake with a backdrop of the Annapurna range reflected in the water. Visit the World Peace Pagoda perched on a hilltop for panoramic mountain and lake views. Explore the natural cave system at Mahendra Cave and enjoy fresh local trout and traditional Newari cuisine at lakeside restaurants.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival day - no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrival day - no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect baggage, and arrange pre-booked or shared taxi transfer toward Pokhara (gateway to Annapurna region). Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort upon arrival. Freshen up and rest.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport food)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight meal)
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack at the airport or a 24-hour dhaba near the road if available during transfer. Budget: ~200-300 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival — prioritize rest. Confirm resort check-in details in advance. Keep some Nepali Rupees (NPR) handy for taxi and tips. Exchange currency at the airport for convenience.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery after late arrival. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort or a nearby local tea house. Take a slow orientation walk around the immediate resort area and lakeside (Phewa Lake, Pokhara) to acclimatize and get your bearings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Lakeside Pokhara (Baidam area) on foot — browse local trekking gear shops for any last-minute budget equipment rentals, visit the Pokhara Bazaar, and check out the vibrant street stalls. Visit the Bindhyabasini Temple nearby for a cultural introduction.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along Phewa Lake promenade at sunset. Enjoy the reflection of the Annapurna range on the lake. Have dinner at a local Lakeside restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Dal Bhat set at a local tea house near resort — ~200-300 NPR
meals.lunch: Momos (dumplings) and butter tea at a street stall in Pokhara Bazaar — ~150-250 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or Thukpa noodle soup at a budget Lakeside restaurant — ~300-400 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Use Day 2 to finalize trekking permits. You will need the ACAP (Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) ~3,000 NPR and TIMS Card ~2,000 NPR — obtainable at the Nepal Tourism Board office in Lakeside. Stay hydrated and start adjusting to the altitude.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning boat ride on Phewa Lake to the Tal Barahi Temple (island temple) — a peaceful spiritual experience. Boat hire costs ~500-700 NPR per hour. Return to shore and enjoy views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) reflected in the lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara (entry ~400 NPR) — an excellent introduction to the Himalayan peaks, mountaineering history, and Annapurna range geography. Great preparation for the trek ahead.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free cultural program or live folk music at a Lakeside restaurant. Pack your trekking bag and prepare gear for the Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) or Poon Hill trek starting tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Tibetan bread with honey and tea at a lakeside cafe — ~200 NPR
meals.lunch: Vegetable fried rice or noodles at a local eatery near the museum — ~250-350 NPR
meals.dinner: Nepali thali (full set meal) at a budget restaurant — ~350-450 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Decide on your trekking route today — Poon Hill (4-5 days, easier, budget-friendly) or Annapurna Base Camp (7-9 days, moderate, slightly higher cost). Poon Hill is recommended for budget trekkers. Hire a local guide optionally (~1,500-2,000 NPR/day) or trek independently with a good map.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning local bus or shared jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul (trek starting point) — ~2-3 hours, cost ~200-300 NPR. Begin trekking from Nayapul toward Tikhedhunga through terraced fields, suspension bridges, and rhododendron forests.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Tikhedhunga uphill to Ulleri — a challenging 3,000+ stone staircase climb through dense forest. Arrive at Ulleri (1,960m) and check into a basic teahouse/lodge.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at Ulleri teahouse. Enjoy panoramic views of the Modi Khola valley. Socialize with fellow trekkers at the lodge common room.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or eggs with toast at Pokhara before departure — ~200-250 NPR
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Tikhedhunga — ~400-500 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Ulleri teahouse — ~500-600 NPR (prices increase on the trail)

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 1. Distance: ~10-12 km. Elevation gain: ~1,000m. Start early to avoid afternoon heat. Carry 2-3 liters of water. Teahouse accommodation in Ulleri: ~300-500 NPR per night (often free or discounted if you eat meals there).

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and trek from Ulleri through rhododendron and oak forests to Ghorepani (2,860m). The trail offers stunning views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South. Arrive at Ghorepani by late morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check into a teahouse in Ghorepani. Rest and acclimatize. Take a short afternoon walk around the village to explore local culture and enjoy mountain views. Visit the local shops for hot ginger tea.
day_by_day.evening: Prepare for the pre-dawn Poon Hill hike tomorrow. Early dinner and early bedtime. Watch the sunset over the Himalayan peaks from Ghorepani village.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with banana and tea at Ulleri teahouse — ~300-400 NPR
meals.lunch: Vegetable soup and chapati at a trail teahouse — ~400-500 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Ghorepani teahouse — ~550-650 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 2. Distance: ~8 km. Elevation: 900m gain. Altitude at Ghorepani is 2,860m — drink plenty of water, avoid alcohol, and rest well. Set alarm for 4:30 AM for Poon Hill sunrise hike tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up at 4:30 AM. Hike 45-60 minutes to Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210m) for the iconic 360-degree sunrise panorama of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre. One of the most spectacular sunrise views in the world. Entry fee: ~100 NPR.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for breakfast, then trek onward to Tadapani (2,630m) through beautiful rhododendron forest — stunning in October with clear skies. Check into teahouse at Tadapani.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Tadapani with views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Enjoy the quiet mountain village atmosphere. Journal your experiences and charge devices if available.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea/coffee on Poon Hill, then full breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse on return — ~350-450 NPR
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at a trail stop — ~400-500 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at Tadapani teahouse — ~550-650 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 3. Poon Hill is the highlight of the circuit — dress warmly (it will be cold before sunrise in October, around 0-5°C at the top). Carry a headlamp. Distance today: ~12 km total including Poon Hill.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chomrong (2,170m) — a long but rewarding descent and ascent through beautiful forest and terraced farmland. Chomrong is the last major village before the Annapurna Sanctuary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chomrong. Explore the village, which has great views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre. Visit the Chomrong Khola (stream) and the local gompa (Buddhist monastery). Rest and rehydrate.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a well-earned rest at a Chomrong teahouse. The village has slightly better facilities than deeper trail stops. Chat with other trekkers and plan the route ahead.

meals.breakfast: Eggs on toast and tea at Tadapani — ~300-400 NPR
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at a mid-trail teahouse — ~500-600 NPR
meals.dinner: Garlic soup (great for altitude) and Dal Bhat at Chomrong — ~600-700 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 4. Distance: ~10 km. This is a good checkpoint — ensure you are feeling well before proceeding toward the Sanctuary. If any altitude sickness symptoms appear, descend immediately. Teahouses in Chomrong: ~400-600 NPR/night.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chomrong down steep stone steps to Sinuwa, then through bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo (2,310m). The trail follows the Modi Khola river gorge — dramatic and beautiful.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Bamboo to Dovan (2,600m). The trail narrows and the gorge deepens. Arrive at Dovan teahouse for overnight stay.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at Dovan. The altitude begins to increase more noticeably here. Drink plenty of water and avoid overexertion. Enjoy the sounds of the river and forest at night.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Chomrong — ~350-450 NPR
meals.lunch: Fried noodles or soup at Bamboo teahouse — ~500-600 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Dovan teahouse — ~600-700 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 5. Distance: ~10 km. Elevation: gradual gain to 2,600m. Watch for leeches on the trail in forested sections (October is post-monsoon — some may still be present). Salt or insect repellent helps.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Dovan through Himalaya Hotel (2,920m) and Hinku Cave to Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m. The landscape transforms dramatically — open glacial moraines, towering peaks, and the iconic Fishtail Mountain up close.
day_by_day.afternoon: From MBC, continue the final push to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m. Arrive at ABC and soak in the breathtaking 360-degree amphitheater of Himalayan giants: Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre.
day_by_day.evening: Witness the alpenglow on the peaks at sunset from ABC — a truly unforgettable experience. Check into teahouse at ABC. Rest and acclimatize carefully.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Dovan — ~400-500 NPR
meals.lunch: Hot soup and bread at Himalaya Hotel teahouse — ~550-650 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at ABC teahouse — ~700-800 NPR (prices are highest here)

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 6. This is the most demanding day — 1,500m elevation gain. Start very early (6:00 AM). Altitude sickness risk is real at 4,130m. Symptoms: headache, nausea, dizziness. Descend immediately if severe. Carry Diamox if prescribed. Water from teahouses: ~100-150 NPR/bottle.

day_by_day.morning: Wake before sunrise to witness the golden light hitting the Annapurna massif at dawn — one of the most spectacular mountain panoramas on Earth. Take time to explore around ABC, photograph the glaciers, and absorb the high-altitude environment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin descent from ABC back to Bamboo (2,310m) — a long but rewarding downhill trek retracing the route through MBC, Dovan, and Himalaya Hotel. The descent is much faster than the ascent.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo teahouse. Rest tired legs. Celebrate reaching ABC with fellow trekkers over hot tea and snacks.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge and tea at ABC — ~500-600 NPR
meals.lunch: Soup and noodles at Dovan or Himalaya Hotel on the way down — ~500-600 NPR
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Bamboo teahouse — ~550-650 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 7. Descent day — knees will feel the pressure on steep sections. Use trekking poles if available. Distance: ~16 km downhill. October skies are usually crystal clear — excellent photography conditions in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo back to Chomrong, ascending the long stone staircase. Enjoy the views of Annapurna South that now feel familiar. Stop at Sinuwa for a rest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Chomrong down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m). Jhinu Danda has famous natural hot springs along the Modi Khola river — a perfect reward for tired trekking legs.
day_by_day.evening: Soak in the Jhinu Danda natural hot springs (entry ~200-300 NPR) as the sun sets over the valley. Pure bliss after days of trekking. Stay overnight at Jhinu Danda teahouse.

meals.breakfast: Tibetan bread and honey at Bamboo — ~300-400 NPR
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at Chomrong — ~550-650 NPR
meals.dinner: Pasta or fried rice at Jhinu Danda teahouse — ~500-600 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 8. The hot springs are a beloved highlight of the ABC trek — do not miss them. Distance: ~10 km. Teahouse accommodation at Jhinu Danda: ~300-500 NPR. Bring flip flops for the hot spring pools.

day_by_day.morning: Final trekking day. Trek from Jhinu Danda through Chhomrong and down to Nayapul via the lower trail through Syauli Bazaar and Birethanti. The trail passes through beautiful lowland villages and farmland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Nayapul and board a local bus or shared jeep back to Pokhara (~2-3 hours, ~200-300 NPR). Return to Aegean Bliss Resort. Shower, do laundry, and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate completing the Annapurna trek with a proper sit-down dinner at a Lakeside restaurant. Treat yourself slightly — you've earned it!

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Jhinu Danda — ~300-400 NPR
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at Birethanti teahouse — ~400-500 NPR
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner — Nepali thali or grilled dishes at a Lakeside Pokhara restaurant — ~500-700 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Trekking Day 9 (final). Total trek: ~9 days, ~80-90 km, max elevation 4,130m. Well done! Rest well tonight. Distance today: ~12 km trekking + bus ride. Arrive back in Pokhara by late afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike or take a boat across Phewa Lake and climb up for panoramic views of the Annapurna range and Pokhara city. Entry is free.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Seti River Gorge viewpoints around Pokhara — the river cuts dramatically through the city underground. Also explore the old Pokhara Bazaar and Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave near the Davis Falls (~50 NPR entry). Davis Falls (Patale Chhango) is a unique waterfall that disappears underground.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening at Lakeside Pokhara. Browse souvenir shops for budget gifts — pashmina scarves, Thangka paintings, singing bowls, and handmade crafts. Enjoy a final lakeside dinner with mountain views.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes with maple syrup and coffee at a Lakeside cafe — ~250-350 NPR
meals.lunch: Buff (buffalo) momos and lassi at a local restaurant — ~300-400 NPR
meals.dinner: Set Nepali thali with dessert at a budget Lakeside restaurant — ~400-600 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Recovery day — let your body rest after the demanding trek. Legs may be sore — gentle walking only. Consider a budget massage at a Lakeside spa (~500-800 NPR/hour) to help muscle recovery. Pack your bags for departure tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Annapurna/Pokhara region. Wake up early for one last sunrise view of the Annapurna range from Pokhara lakeside — the mountains glow pink and gold in the morning light. Take a peaceful final walk along Phewa Lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange transport to Pokhara Regional Airport or Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu depending on departure flight. If time allows before transfer, visit the Barahi Ghat lakeside temple one last time.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Nepal carrying incredible memories of the Himalayas. If overnight in Kathmandu before departure, explore Thamel neighborhood for last-minute shopping and a final Nepali meal.

meals.breakfast: Full Nepali breakfast at the resort or a Lakeside cafe — ~300-400 NPR
meals.lunch: Quick Dal Bhat or sandwich before departure — ~250-350 NPR
meals.dinner: Airport meal or Thamel restaurant dinner if overnight in Kathmandu — ~400-600 NPR

day_by_day.notes: Departure day. Keep all permits (ACAP, TIMS) as souvenirs — they make great mementos. Estimated total budget for 14 days: ~NPR 45,000-65,000 (~USD 330-480) including permits, accommodation, food, transport, and activities. Nepal is one of the world's best value trekking destinations!

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect baggage, and arrange pre-booked taxi or hotel transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort in the Annapurna region (Pokhara gateway). Check in, freshen up, and get a good night's rest.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Light snack or dal bhat at a 24-hour dhaba near the airport if hungry upon arrival (~$5–8)

day_by_day.notes: Travel day only. The drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara (gateway to Annapurna) takes approximately 6–7 hours by road or 25 minutes by domestic flight. If a connecting domestic flight is arranged, confirm it is scheduled for the next morning. Keep energy for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Morning transfer from Kathmandu to Pokhara — either a scenic domestic flight (recommended, ~$80–100 one-way) or tourist bus (~$15–20, 6–7 hrs). Arrive in Pokhara and check into Aegean Bliss Resort. Freshen up and enjoy the stunning Phewa Lake views from the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation walk along Lakeside (Baidam) in Pokhara — explore local shops, trekking gear stores, and the vibrant street scene. Visit the Phewa Lake shoreline and arrange a short rowboat ride (~$5–8 per hour) for a peaceful introduction to the Annapurna backdrop.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the Lakeside promenade at sunset. Watch the Annapurna and Machapuchare (Fishtail) peaks glow in the alpenglow from the lakefront.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or café stop in Kathmandu before departure (~$4–7)
meals.lunch: Thakali set meal at a local Pokhara restaurant (~$6–10) — try Momos (dumplings) as a starter
meals.dinner: Dinner at a Lakeside restaurant such as Caffe Concerto or similar mid-range spot — pasta, pizza, or Nepali thali (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Nepal — weather is typically clear with excellent mountain views. Acclimatize gently today. Purchase or rent trekking gear in Pokhara if needed. Confirm TIMS card and Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP) arrangements for upcoming trek days.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Sarangkot Hill for the iconic sunrise over the Annapurna range. Depart resort by 5:00–5:30 AM via taxi (~$8–10). Watch the sun paint Annapurna I, II, III, IV, Machapuchare, and Dhaulagiri in shades of gold and pink — a truly unforgettable experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Pokhara and visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — a 45-minute hike up from the southern lakeside or short taxi ride. Panoramic 360-degree views of Pokhara valley, Phewa Lake, and the Himalayas. Explore the pagoda grounds and meditate in peaceful surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the Bindhyabasini Temple, one of Pokhara's most sacred Hindu temples, for the evening aarti (prayer ceremony). Explore the Old Bazaar area for local handicrafts and souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Light snack or tea before Sarangkot sunrise; full breakfast at a Sarangkot viewpoint café upon return (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at a traditional Nepali restaurant near the Old Bazaar (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Moondance Restaurant or similar Lakeside eatery — try Nepali-style grilled fish from Phewa Lake (~$10–14)

day_by_day.notes: Obtain your TIMS (Trekkers' Information Management System) card and ACAP permit today if not done yesterday — available at the Nepal Tourism Board office in Lakeside (~$30 total for both). Carry passport photos. Pack trekking bag tonight for early start tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the Annapurna Circuit / Poon Hill Trek! Take an early taxi or local bus from Pokhara to Nayapul (1,070m) — approximately 1.5 hours (~$15–20 by taxi). Start trekking from Nayapul through Birethanti (ACAP checkpoint) and continue along the Modi Khola river valley to Tikhedhunga (1,540m). Trek duration: approximately 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Tikhedhunga, ascending the famous stone staircase to Ulleri (2,073m) — a steep but rewarding climb of approximately 3,200 stone steps through rhododendron and oak forests. Arrive at Ulleri and rest at a teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Ulleri teahouse, enjoy views of the surrounding hills, and socialize with fellow trekkers. The village offers beautiful terraced fields and traditional Gurung architecture.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at resort before departure or at Birethanti teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat or noodle soup at a Tikhedhunga teahouse (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner at Ulleri — dal bhat, vegetable curry, or pasta (~$6–10)

day_by_day.notes: Teahouse accommodation in Ulleri costs approximately $5–15 per night. October weather is ideal — clear skies, cool temperatures, minimal rain. Carry at least 2 liters of water. Trekking poles recommended for the steep Ulleri staircase ascent.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Ulleri (2,073m) through Banthanti and Nangethanti to Ghorepani (2,860m). The trail winds through dense rhododendron forests — in October the foliage is rich green. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours with moderate ascent.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon. Rest and acclimatize to the altitude. Explore the village and surrounding viewpoints. Optional short hike to a nearby ridge for afternoon Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South views.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the teahouse atmosphere in Ghorepani — one of the most popular stops on the Poon Hill circuit. Warm up by the communal fire with other trekkers. Clear October nights reveal spectacular star-filled skies.

meals.breakfast: Porridge, eggs, and tea at Ulleri teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or stop at Banthanti teahouse — vegetable noodle soup (~$4–7)
meals.dinner: Hearty dal bhat at Ghorepani teahouse — the classic trekker's meal, unlimited refills (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: Set an alarm for 4:30–5:00 AM tomorrow for the Poon Hill sunrise hike. Ghorepani has multiple teahouses — book in advance during peak October season or arrive early afternoon. Altitude: 2,860m — drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) — depart teahouse at 5:00 AM with headlamp for the 45-minute ascent. Witness one of Nepal's most celebrated sunrises with a 360-degree panorama of Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machapuchare, Annapurna I, II, III, and IV. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghorepani via Deurali to Tadapani (2,590m) through spectacular rhododendron and magnolia forest. The trail offers continuous Annapurna range views. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into Tadapani teahouse. The village sits on a ridge with sweeping views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Peak, 6,993m) and Annapurna South. Enjoy the peaceful mountain atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Tea/coffee and snacks at Poon Hill viewpoint kiosk (~$2–3); full breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse upon return (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch at Deurali — garlic soup (altitude remedy) and bread (~$4–7)
meals.dinner: Pasta or dal bhat at Tadapani teahouse (~$6–9)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee: approximately NPR 100 (~$0.75). The sunrise at Poon Hill is one of the highlights of any Nepal trip — dress in warm layers as temperatures can drop to 0–5°C at dawn in October. The Ghorepani–Tadapani trail is less crowded and very scenic.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani down through rhododendron forest to Chhomrong (2,170m), a large Gurung village with stunning views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. The descent involves stone staircases and forest trails. Trek duration: approximately 4 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Chhomrong village — visit the local monastery, interact with Gurung families, and enjoy the terraced fields. Optional short hike to the upper village for panoramic views of the Annapurna Sanctuary entrance.
day_by_day.evening: Rest and recovery day in Chhomrong. Enjoy a massage at one of the teahouses offering basic services. Watch the sunset over the Annapurna massif from the village viewpoint.

meals.breakfast: Muesli, honey, and tea at Tadapani teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a Chhomrong teahouse — try the local apple cider (~$6–9)
meals.dinner: Grilled vegetables, rice, and lentil soup at Chhomrong teahouse (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong is the last major resupply point before the Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) route. Stock up on snacks, water purification tablets, and any needed supplies. Teahouse accommodation: ~$8–15/night. This is a rest/acclimatization day — do not rush.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the ascent toward Annapurna Base Camp. Trek from Chhomrong down to Sinuwa (2,360m) and continue through bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo (2,310m). The trail follows the Modi Khola gorge deeper into the Annapurna Sanctuary. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Bamboo through Doban to Himalaya Hotel (2,920m). The landscape transitions from forest to more open alpine terrain. Keep an eye out for Himalayan Tahr (mountain goat), langur monkeys, and various bird species.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Himalaya Hotel teahouse. The gorge narrows dramatically here — towering cliffs on both sides create an awe-inspiring canyon atmosphere. Clear evenings reveal a narrow strip of star-filled sky above.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and Nepali milk tea at Chhomrong teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at Bamboo teahouse (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and vegetable curry at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: The Modi Khola gorge section is prone to rockfall — move steadily and avoid stopping under overhanging cliffs. Altitude increases significantly today. Drink 3–4 liters of water. Garlic soup is recommended at every meal for altitude acclimatization.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Himalaya Hotel through Hinku Cave to Deurali (3,230m). The trail emerges from the gorge into a wider valley with increasingly dramatic mountain views. In October, there may be light snow on higher sections — trekking poles essential. Trek duration: approximately 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Deurali to Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m). The trail crosses the Modi Khola and ascends steeply through a glacial valley. Arrive at MBC with breathtaking close-up views of the sacred Machapuchare (Fishtail) peak — climbing is prohibited on this mountain.
day_by_day.evening: Acclimatization evening at MBC. Walk around the camp area to help the body adjust to 3,700m altitude. Watch the last light fade on the surrounding peaks — Machapuchare, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Gangapurna.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and garlic soup at Himalaya Hotel (~$5–7)
meals.lunch: Hot noodle soup at Deurali teahouse (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and hot lemon tea at MBC teahouse (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Altitude at MBC is 3,700m — symptoms of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) include headache, nausea, dizziness, and fatigue. If symptoms are severe, descend immediately. Temperatures at MBC in October: daytime 5–10°C, nighttime -5 to -10°C. Bring a quality sleeping bag rated to -10°C.

day_by_day.morning: The grand highlight — trek from MBC to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC, 4,130m)! Depart at 6:00 AM to arrive at ABC for the full morning mountain experience. The final 2-hour ascent crosses a glacial moraine with increasingly dramatic views. Arrive at ABC surrounded by a 360-degree amphitheater of 8,000m peaks: Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Gangapurna, Glacier Dome, and Machapuchare.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore ABC — walk to the memorial stupas honoring climbers who perished on Annapurna, one of the world's most dangerous 8,000m peaks. Photography session with the incredible mountain panorama. Rest and soak in this once-in-a-lifetime environment.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at ABC — watch the Annapurna massif transition through golden, orange, and pink hues as the sun sets. The silence and scale of the surroundings create a profoundly moving experience. Return to teahouse for a warm meal.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at MBC — tea, biscuits, and porridge (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Hot soup and snacks at ABC teahouse (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and hot chocolate at ABC teahouse (~$10–14)

day_by_day.notes: ABC altitude: 4,130m. This is the highest point of the itinerary. Spend maximum 1 night here. Teahouse facilities are basic at this altitude — sleeping bags are essential. Weather can change rapidly — be prepared for snow or high winds. This is the culmination of the trek.

day_by_day.morning: Wake before dawn for the ABC sunrise — Annapurna I glows an extraordinary deep red/orange before the sun crests the horizon. After sunrise photography and breakfast, begin the descent from ABC back to MBC and continue down to Bamboo (2,310m). Descending is significantly faster — approximately 5–6 hours total.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent through the bamboo and rhododendron forest. The lower altitude brings warmer temperatures and lush greenery — a pleasant contrast to the high alpine environment. Arrive at Bamboo teahouse by mid-afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relax tired legs at Bamboo teahouse. Celebrate the successful ABC trek with fellow trekkers. The lower altitude means better sleep and improved appetite.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise tea and porridge at ABC teahouse (~$5–7)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or quick teahouse stop at Deurali (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Celebratory dal bhat feast at Bamboo teahouse — unlimited refills (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: Descending from 4,130m to 2,310m in one day is manageable but hard on the knees — use trekking poles and take regular breaks. Blister care is important on descent. The return journey retraces the ascent route through the Modi Khola gorge.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo back through Sinuwa to Chhomrong (2,170m). The ascent back up to Chhomrong is the most challenging part of the return — approximately 3–4 hours. Take it steady and enjoy the forest scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent from Chhomrong through Jhinu Danda (1,780m). Jhinu Danda is famous for its natural hot springs — a perfect reward for tired trekking legs! Soak in the riverside hot spring pools (~$3–5 entry) for 1–2 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Overnight at Jhinu Danda teahouse. The village sits above the Modi Khola with lovely valley views. Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere after the hot spring soak.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Bamboo teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at Chhomrong teahouse — well deserved after the climb (~$6–9)
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry and rice at Jhinu Danda teahouse (~$6–9)

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are one of the most popular post-trek rewards on the Annapurna circuit. The pools are located a 20-minute walk below the village on the riverbank. Bring a towel and flip-flops. The water temperature is approximately 40–45°C — blissful for sore muscles.

day_by_day.morning: Final trekking day — descend from Jhinu Danda to Nayapul via Kimche and Birethanti. The trail follows the Modi Khola valley through terraced farmland and traditional villages. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours. Arrive at Nayapul and arrange taxi back to Pokhara (~$15–20).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Pokhara and Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, shower, and enjoy the luxury of a proper bed, hot shower, and resort amenities after 10 days of teahouse trekking. Spend the afternoon relaxing by Phewa Lake — optional boat ride or lakeside stroll.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner in Pokhara's Lakeside district. Treat yourself to a proper restaurant meal to mark the completion of the Annapurna trek. Browse souvenir shops for local handicrafts, Thangka paintings, and pashmina scarves.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast at Jhinu Danda (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Roadside dal bhat near Birethanti or Nayapul (~$4–7)
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a Lakeside restaurant — try Nepali fusion cuisine, local trout, or wood-fired pizza (~$15–20)

day_by_day.notes: The trek is complete! Total trekking distance over 10 days: approximately 110–120 km. Total elevation gain/loss: approximately 4,500m ascent and descent. This is a significant achievement. Ensure you have your TIMS card stamped at all checkpoints for the record.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — sleep in, enjoy a resort breakfast, and relax by Phewa Lake. Optional final sunrise view from the resort terrace or a short morning walk along the lakefront. Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara (~$10 entry) — a world-class museum dedicated to Himalayan mountaineering history.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last afternoon in Pokhara — visit the Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave (sacred Hindu cave temple near Davis Falls, ~$2 entry) and the Davis Falls (Patale Chhango) nearby. Final souvenir shopping in Lakeside. Pack bags for departure and arrange airport/bus transfer.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a Pokhara rooftop restaurant with Annapurna range views — reflect on 14 incredible days in Nepal. Arrange early morning transfer to Pokhara Airport for domestic flight back to Kathmandu, or onward international connections.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — eggs, fresh fruit, yogurt, and Nepali tea (~$8–12)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a Lakeside café — try the local apple pie (Pokhara is famous for it) and masala tea (~$5–8)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant — Nepali set dinner with local raksi (rice wine) or Everest beer (~$15–20)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm return flight details and arrange airport transfer in advance. Pokhara Airport is approximately 15–20 minutes from Lakeside by taxi (~$8–10). Allow extra time for potential mountain weather delays on domestic flights. Bring home memories, photos, and perhaps a handmade Thangka painting or lokta paper journal as a souvenir of this extraordinary journey.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Trek to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas. Watch the golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a stunning alpenglow display. The hike from Ghorepani takes about 1.5 hours and is suitable for moderate fitness levels.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Private luxury transfer arranged to Aegean Bliss Resort. Welcome drink and late-night light refreshments upon check-in. Resort orientation and room settling.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight or airport dining
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in-flight or airport dining
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome platter and herbal teas arranged by the resort upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Ensure private airport transfer is pre-booked. Porter service for luggage included. Resort staff should be briefed for a late-night arrival. Keep Day 1 light to combat jet lag and altitude acclimatization.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely late breakfast and resort orientation. Gentle yoga session on the resort terrace with panoramic Annapurna range views led by a resident instructor. Light stretching and breathing exercises to begin altitude acclimatization.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided nature walk through the surrounding rhododendron and oak forests near the resort. Explore local flora and fauna with a private naturalist guide. Visit a nearby traditional Gurung village to experience local culture and architecture.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset viewing from the resort's premium terrace with curated Himalayan cocktails. Welcome dinner at the resort's signature restaurant featuring Nepali fusion cuisine prepared by the executive chef.

meals.breakfast: Lavish resort breakfast buffet featuring fresh local fruits, Nepali breads (sel roti), eggs to order, and imported cheeses
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's garden café — Nepali thali set with organic local vegetables and herbal teas
meals.dinner: Multi-course Nepali fusion tasting menu at the resort's signature restaurant — featuring yak cheese appetizers, mountain lentil soup, slow-cooked lamb curry, and cardamom crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: Day focused on gentle acclimatization. Avoid strenuous activity on Day 2. Stay well-hydrated. Resort elevation should be noted — consult with the resort's in-house wellness advisor regarding altitude protocols.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided hike to a scenic local viewpoint above the resort with unobstructed views of the Annapurna Massif and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain). Sunrise photography session with a professional mountain photographer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cultural immersion experience — private cooking class at the resort learning to prepare traditional Nepali dishes including dal bhat, momos, and gundruk. Followed by a relaxing Himalayan herbal spa treatment at the resort spa.
day_by_day.evening: Bonfire evening at the resort's outdoor lounge with live traditional Gurung music performance. Stargazing session with a telescope provided by the resort in the pristine Himalayan night sky.

meals.breakfast: Healthy power breakfast — overnight oats with local honey, fresh mountain berries, avocado toast, and green smoothies
meals.lunch: Picnic-style gourmet lunch prepared by the resort kitchen, enjoyed at the scenic viewpoint
meals.dinner: Traditional Nepali set dinner by the bonfire — grilled mountain trout, seasonal vegetable curries, rice, and local raksi (rice wine) or premium wines

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Annapurna — expect clear skies and excellent visibility. Dress in warm layers for evening as temperatures drop significantly after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure for the iconic Poon Hill Sunrise Hike. Trek to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m elevation with a private expert guide. Witness one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas with 360-degree views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, II, III, IV, and Machhapuchhre.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend from Poon Hill at a leisurely pace, stopping at Ghorepani village for rest and exploration. Visit the local tea houses and interact with Magar and Gurung community members. Return to resort by private vehicle from Nayapul.
day_by_day.evening: Full-body rejuvenating massage at the resort spa to soothe trekking muscles. Private hot stone therapy and aromatherapy session using locally sourced Himalayan herbs.

meals.breakfast: Pre-trek energizing breakfast at 04:00 — protein-rich eggs, granola, fresh fruit, and thermos of premium Nepali tea for the trail
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed lunch enjoyed at Ghorepani — artisan sandwiches, local cheese, dried fruits, nuts, and energy bars
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at the resort's rooftop restaurant — five-course Himalayan-inspired menu with panoramic mountain views by candlelight

day_by_day.notes: Wake-up call at 03:30 for the Poon Hill hike. Trek requires moderate fitness. Private porter service available for luggage on the trail. Carry warm layers, gloves, and a headlamp. This is the signature experience of the itinerary.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the Poon Hill hike. Gentle morning meditation session on the resort's Himalayan-view deck. Optional light stretching with the resort's wellness instructor.
day_by_day.afternoon: Helicopter excursion over the Annapurna Conservation Area — private luxury helicopter flight over the Annapurna Sanctuary, Thorong La Pass, and Mustang region for breathtaking aerial perspectives. Approximately 2-hour scenic flight.
day_by_day.evening: Private photography review session with the resort's in-house photographer to curate the best images from the helicopter flight and Poon Hill trek. Followed by a wine and cheese tasting event featuring Himalayan-region wines and imported selections.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely brunch — eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit platters, and freshly pressed juices
meals.lunch: Light in-flight refreshments and gourmet snack box during helicopter excursion
meals.dinner: Intimate candlelit dinner for two at the resort's private dining pavilion — curated seven-course degustation menu with wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter excursion subject to weather conditions — October typically offers excellent flying weather. Pre-book helicopter well in advance. Minimum 2 passengers typically required. Altitude during flight reaches 5,000m+ — no disembarkation at high altitude on this excursion.

day_by_day.morning: Guided trek along the Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) approach trail — Day 1 of a 2-day ABC experience. Trek from Chhomrong village through bamboo and rhododendron forests toward Himalaya Hotel. Private guide, porter, and luxury tented camp or premium teahouse accommodation arranged.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through Dovan and Himalaya village, ascending through the Modi Khola valley. Wildlife spotting opportunities — Himalayan tahr, snow leopard tracks, and diverse birdlife including Danphe (national bird of Nepal).
day_by_day.evening: Arrival at premium Himalaya Hotel teahouse accommodation. Hot shower, warm yak wool blankets, and a cozy fireside dinner. Early to bed for the ABC push tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Hearty trekking breakfast at the resort before departure — porridge, eggs, toast, butter, jam, and unlimited tea
meals.lunch: Trail lunch at a traditional teahouse in Chhomrong — dal bhat, vegetable soup, and local herbal tea
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner at Himalaya Hotel — garlic soup (altitude remedy), pasta, vegetable curry, and hot lemon honey drinks

day_by_day.notes: Garlic soup is highly recommended at altitude as a natural remedy for altitude sickness. Stay well-hydrated. Ascent is gradual — pace yourself. Private porter carries all heavy luggage. Carry only a daypack with essentials.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure from Himalaya Hotel continuing toward Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m). Trek through Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m with stunning views of Fishtail Mountain. Arrive at ABC for a triumphant sunrise moment surrounded by the Annapurna Sanctuary amphitheater.
day_by_day.afternoon: Exploration of Annapurna Base Camp — photography, reflection, and guided interpretation of the surrounding peaks by your expert mountain guide. Begin descent back toward Bamboo or Chhomrong for overnight.
day_by_day.evening: Overnight at a premium teahouse at Bamboo or Chhomrong. Hot shower, relaxation, and a well-deserved dinner. Private vehicle arranged for return to resort the following morning.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at 05:00 — energy bars, tea, and fruit before the final push to ABC
meals.lunch: Celebratory lunch at ABC teahouse — hot noodle soup, fried rice, and hot chocolate
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner at Bamboo/Chhomrong — hearty dal bhat, mixed vegetable curry, and warm apple cider

day_by_day.notes: Reaching ABC at 4,130m is a significant altitude gain. Watch for symptoms of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) — headache, nausea, dizziness. Descend immediately if symptoms worsen. October weather is generally stable but carry rain gear and extra warm layers. This is the most physically demanding day of the itinerary.

day_by_day.morning: Morning descent from Chhomrong/Bamboo back to Nayapul via private guide. Scenic trail through terraced farmlands and traditional villages. Private luxury vehicle waiting at Nayapul for transfer back to the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort. Full-body recovery spa treatment — deep tissue massage, Himalayan salt scrub, and hot tub soak. Resort pool relaxation and complete rest.
day_by_day.evening: Celebration dinner at the resort to mark the successful Annapurna Base Camp trek. Private chef's table experience with a customized menu. Toast with Nepali Khukri rum or premium champagne.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast before descent — egg fried rice, toast, and tea
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort upon return — fresh salads, grilled chicken, and cold-pressed juices
meals.dinner: Private chef's table celebration dinner — bespoke 8-course menu with wine pairings, concluding with a personalized Himalayan-themed dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Descent is easier on lungs but harder on knees — use trekking poles. Carry knee support if needed. Upon return to resort, request the in-house wellness advisor for a post-trek recovery consultation. Excellent day to review and back up all trek photography.

day_by_day.morning: Complete rest and leisure morning. Late breakfast in bed option available. Optional gentle resort pool swim or jacuzzi soak. Read, journal, or simply enjoy the mountain views from your private balcony.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided cultural tour of Pokhara city — visit the Bindhyabasini Temple, Barahi Temple on Phewa Lake, and the International Mountain Museum showcasing Himalayan climbing history and culture.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset boat ride on the serene Phewa Lake with private boatman. Reflections of Machhapuchhre in the lake at golden hour. Followed by dinner at one of Pokhara's finest lakeside restaurants.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast service — continental spread with fresh pastries, yogurt parfait, seasonal fruits, and specialty Nepali coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at a premium Pokhara restaurant — Nepali-European fusion cuisine with lake views
meals.dinner: Dinner at a top-rated Pokhara lakeside restaurant — grilled river fish, Newari cuisine specialties, and premium cocktails by the waterfront

day_by_day.notes: Pokhara is approximately 30-45 minutes from the Annapurna foothills resort area. Private vehicle transfer recommended. October evenings on Phewa Lake are magical — bring a light jacket. The International Mountain Museum is one of the finest mountain museums in Asia.

day_by_day.morning: Paragliding experience over Pokhara and the Annapurna range — tandem paragliding flight from Sarangkot Hill with a certified instructor. One of the world's premier paragliding destinations offering 30-45 minute flights with panoramic Himalayan views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit to the stunning Devi's Fall (Patale Chhango) and Gupteshwor Cave — natural wonders near Pokhara. Explore the cave's underground river system with a private guide. Followed by a visit to the Tibetan Refugee Camp at Tashiling for handcrafted souvenir shopping.
day_by_day.evening: Luxury rooftop dinner at one of Pokhara's finest establishments with live jazz music. Curated cocktail menu featuring locally inspired spirits and premium international labels.

meals.breakfast: Pre-paragliding energizing breakfast — protein smoothies, avocado toast, poached eggs, and green tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet lunch at a lakeside café in Pokhara — wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, and imported wine
meals.dinner: Rooftop fine dining in Pokhara — contemporary Nepali cuisine with international influences, live jazz, and sommelier-selected wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Paragliding is weather-dependent — October is one of the best months with stable thermals and clear skies. Minimum weight requirements apply (typically 30-110 kg). Book in advance with a reputable operator. GoPro footage included with most premium packages.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise hike to Sarangkot Hill (1,592m) — one of the finest viewpoints above Pokhara offering stunning views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges at dawn. Guided hike with a private naturalist. Photography session at the summit.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxury kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding on Phewa Lake. Followed by a private guided visit to the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — a beautiful Buddhist stupa perched above the lake offering panoramic views.
day_by_day.evening: Traditional Nepali cultural evening at the resort — private performance of Gurung, Magar, and Tharu folk dances and music arranged by the resort. Followed by a traditional Nepali thali feast.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise picnic breakfast at Sarangkot — thermos of Nepali masala tea, fresh sandwiches, seasonal fruits, and local sweets
meals.lunch: Healthy lakeside lunch — fresh salads, grilled vegetables, hummus platter, and cold-pressed juices
meals.dinner: Traditional Nepali thali feast at the resort — an elaborate spread of rice, multiple curries, pickles, papad, and kheer (rice pudding) for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Sarangkot sunrise hike requires a 04:30 wake-up. The hike takes approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour. This is a less strenuous hike suitable for all fitness levels after the demanding ABC trek. The World Peace Pagoda is accessible by boat across Phewa Lake — a unique approach.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Mustang region — private jeep safari to the Kali Gandaki Gorge, the world's deepest gorge, and the ancient walled city of Lo Manthang gateway area. Explore unique Trans-Himalayan landscapes and Tibetan Buddhist culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit ancient cave monasteries and cliff dwellings in the lower Mustang region. Private guide provides in-depth commentary on the unique Mustang Kingdom history and culture. Return journey through dramatic gorge scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort. Relaxing evening with a private Ayurvedic consultation and personalized herbal treatment at the resort spa. Quiet dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Early hearty breakfast before departure — full English breakfast with Nepali additions, fresh juices, and coffee
meals.lunch: Traditional Mustangi cuisine lunch in Jomsom — buckwheat bread, yak butter tea, and local apple products (Mustang is famous for apples)
meals.dinner: Quiet resort dinner — light Mediterranean-style spread with fresh salads, grilled fish, roasted vegetables, and herbal teas

day_by_day.notes: Mustang day trip is approximately a 3-4 hour drive each way from Pokhara/Annapurna area via Beni. Alternatively, a short scenic flight from Pokhara to Jomsom (25 minutes) is highly recommended for a luxury experience. Inner Mustang requires a special restricted area permit — arrange in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final luxury trek day — guided hike along the scenic Mardi Himal trail lower section through pristine forests to High Camp viewpoint. Less crowded than ABC, offering intimate Himalayan experiences with views of Machhapuchhre and Mardi Himal.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from Mardi Himal trail. Afternoon at leisure — final resort pool session, packing, and souvenir organization. Optional visit to a local Gurung artisan workshop for premium handcrafted Nepali souvenirs and Thangka paintings.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell gala dinner at the resort — special arrangement by the resort team. Personalized menu, decorations, and a certificate of achievement for completing the Annapurna Base Camp trek. Live acoustic music performance.

meals.breakfast: Power breakfast for the final hike — quinoa porridge, protein eggs, fresh fruit, and premium Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet trail lunch at a scenic forest clearing — artisan charcuterie board, local cheeses, crusty bread, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Farewell gala dinner — premium five-course menu featuring the best of Nepali and international cuisine, with champagne toast and personalized dessert

day_by_day.notes: Mardi Himal trail is increasingly popular but far less crowded than the main Annapurna Circuit. The lower section is accessible as a day hike. Perfect final trekking experience. Ensure all souvenirs and purchases comply with customs regulations — particularly regarding antiques and wildlife products.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise viewing from the resort terrace with a cup of premium Nepali Himalayan tea. Leisurely checkout process with resort concierge assistance. Final spa treatment — express facial and head massage before departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer to Pokhara Airport or Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu depending on departure flight. En route, optional stop at a premium Nepali handicraft store for last-minute shopping — Pashmina shawls, Thangka art, and hand-carved wooden items.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Nepal. If evening flight, enjoy a final premium dinner at Kathmandu's finest restaurant — Dwarika's Hotel restaurant or Krishnarpan for an authentic Newari farewell feast.

meals.breakfast: Farewell breakfast at the resort — full spread of favorites from the past two weeks, personalized by the chef
meals.lunch: Airport lounge dining or premium restaurant near the airport — light and travel-friendly selections
meals.dinner: Final dinner in Kathmandu (if schedule permits) — Krishnarpan at Dwarika's Hotel for an iconic 22-course Newari tasting menu, or premium airport lounge dining

day_by_day.notes: Confirm departure flight details and arrange private transfer well in advance. Allow extra time for Kathmandu traffic. Resort checkout is typically 12:00 — arrange late checkout if needed for an evening flight. Request a personalized trip memory book or photo album from the resort as a keepsake. Ensure travel insurance documentation is in order for the return journey.
